about: tally-board application mutants for PROPERTY-TESTING P5; each is killed by law Explored via ui.Explore + ui.Defaults.

mutants.name: tally-count-past-limit
mutants.rule: Adding items never exceeds MaxItems (law Explored: count-within-limit).

mutants.name: tally-load-never-settles
mutants.rule: An async sync load settles within the default 2s virtual-time bound (law Explored: loads-settled).

mutants.name: tally-duplicate-button-name
mutants.rule: No two buttons share one accessible name (law Explored: offers-unambiguous).

mutants.name: tally-back-after-delete-defect
mutants.rule: Navigating back to a deleted item route clears selection instead of selecting a missing item (law Explored: selected-exists).
